provenance.defaultTitle: No boundary match — fell back to the default biome

stats.intactnessTitle: Delivering {pct} of the value this land would yield fully intact

yields.heading: Service yields
yields.scale: Bar length = value vs the strongest biome for that service

tev.label: Total Ecosystem Value
tev.annualUnit: per year, across this entire area

asset.label: Standing asset value
asset.sub: worth on the balance sheet, left standing — perpetual flow at {rate}%
asset.subTitle: The annual flow of ecosystem services capitalised as a perpetuity — the balance-sheet value of leaving this land standing

conversion.heading: If converted
conversion.liabilitySub: ~{loss}/yr of lost services, owed in perpetuity — {incidence}
conversion.systemicTagRest: — rare, intact land is load-bearing beyond the parcel itself.
conversion.carbonDebt: + ~{amount} stored carbon released — once, largely irreversibly.
conversion.redLinesHead: ⛔ Cannot be replaced at any price
conversion.redLinesHeadTitle: Red lines, not line items — deliberately left out of the figures above

comparisons.title: Rough comparison — indicative reference figures, not a valuation input

guide.title: What is nature worth?
guide.lead: alpha puts a price on the services ecosystems deliver every year — and on what is lost if the land is converted.

click.title: Click any coloured area
click.body: Each shape is a named ecosystem, coloured by biome. Clicking one opens its full valuation on the right.

numbers.title: Read the three headline figures
numbers.body: Standing asset value — what the land is worth left intact. Total Ecosystem Value — the services it delivers per year. Perpetual liability — the permanent cost if it were converted.

search.title: Value your own area
search.body: Type "lat, lng", a "w, s, e, n" box, or paste a GeoJSON polygon into the search bar.

styles.title: Change the view
styles.body: Use the Biomes panel to filter layers and switch between fill, value bubbles and detailed outlines; toggle Globe / Flat and the currency in the top bar.

guide.note: Figures are indicative, citation-backed reference values — every panel links to its methodology, and the Data Hub lists each source.

compare.capacityTitle: You can compare up to {max} ecosystems at once
compare.capacityFull: Maximum reached — remove one to add another.
compare.title: Compare ecosystems
compare.subtitle: Total Ecosystem Value side by side — {currency} per hectare per year. Add up to {max}.
compare.empty: Pick regions from the left to compare their ecosystem-service yields and Total Ecosystem Value.

dataHub.title: Data Hub
dataHub.subtitle: Every input behind a valuation — where it comes from, how current it is, and what we still need.

market.liveTitle: Fetched live from the market feed
market.staticTitle: Live feed unavailable or not configured — using the documented static reference
market.fallbackNote: One or more live market feeds are off or unreachable, so valuations use the documented static reference values.
market.unavailable: Market data is unavailable right now.

dataHub.error: Could not load the data catalogue from the alpha backend.

esv.sub: Pulls structured ecosystem-service values out of report / TNFD-disclosure prose.
esv.failed: Extraction failed. Is the backend running?
esv.empty: No structured values found in that text.

classify.title: Classify a polygon's biome
classify.sub: Locates a GeoJSON polygon in the ingested boundary data and returns the detected biome + provenance.
classify.invalidJson: That is not valid JSON. Paste a GeoJSON Polygon geometry.
classify.failed: Classification failed. Check the geometry and the backend.
